# Ollama API fixtures

Authored protocol fixtures checked against the pinned [v0.35.0 API types](https://github.com/ollama/ollama/blob/v0.35.0/api/types.go). They are not recorded inference results. Durations are raw nanoseconds and model sizes are bytes. Tests serve these responses from a temporary loopback HTTP server; no external service, real model, download or GPU is used.
